name: Seedream 5.0 Pro
description: ByteDance's full Seedream 5, 1K or 2K. Also on WaveSpeedAI. Also on Comfy Cloud. Also on ToAPIs. Also on OpenRouter. Also on BytePlus ModelArk (ByteDance's own API). Also on Comfy Router. Also on Oxen.ai. Also on Magnific. Adapter written from the provider's docs, not run against the live API yet.

toapis.note: Runs on ToAPIs (a reseller); not run against the live API yet. Crop, mask and references are uploaded to public files.toapis.com URLs. Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area". The model takes aspect presets: a crop of another shape comes back re-framed and is centre-cropped. Resolution 1K or 2K only. Seedream takes no image longer than 3:1: a thin selection gets more context on its short side, and a longer reference layer is refused before any upload.

ark.note: Runs on BytePlus ModelArk, ByteDance's own API for Seedream; not run against the live API yet. The pictures go inline in the request to BytePlus in Johor, Malaysia, which may route a request to its other region; BytePlus names data centres in Malaysia, Indonesia and the EU/EEA for its processing, keeps what its content filter flags for 180 days in Malaysia (its filter page says Malaysia or Singapore), and uses nothing for training without consent. The model must be activated in the ModelArk console first, and a key works only in the region it was made in. Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area". The answer is the crop's own shape at a pixel size inside the model's range, without a watermark. 0.92 to 4.6 megapixels: up to 2.61 MP an image costs $0.045, above that $0.09 (with Highres fix on Maximum a crop goes out at up to 4.6 MP; set it lower for the cheaper size), and every picture after the first (Original on, each reference layer) adds $0.003. At most ten pictures go in (the crop, Original and the reference layers), none steeper than 16:1. The Johor region only: neither the model list nor the region page names 5.0 pro for Dublin.

fal.note: Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area". The crop goes out under a 4 MP budget (fal's image_size is an area range, not a side limit), so a wide selection passes 2048 px on the long side; Size picks the answer's resolution.

wavespeed.note: Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area". WaveSpeed sends the aspect preset closest to the crop.

comfycloud.note: Runs the Partner Node on Comfy Cloud (paid plan, credits). Custom size fitted to the crop (1024 to 2496 px). Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area".

openrouter.note: Runs on OpenRouter (one key for many models); the adapter has run against the live API with GPT Image 2.5, this model not yet. The pictures go inline in the request to OpenRouter, which passes them to ByteDance's Seed (Singapore). Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area". An edit sends no aspect, so the host keeps the crop's shape as its own edit endpoint does (not verified); an answer of another shape is centre-cropped. Resolution auto takes the smallest tier that covers the crop. A picture steeper than 16:1 (the input range ByteDance's ModelArk documents; not verified through OpenRouter) is refused before anything is sent; a thinner selection gets more context instead. At most ten pictures go in (the crop, Original and the reference layers): OpenRouter lists 14, ByteDance's ModelArk documents 10 for 5.0 pro.

comfyrouter.note: Runs on Comfy Router (api.comfy.org) with the Comfy Cloud key, billed in Comfy credits, no paid plan needed; not run against the live API yet. The pictures go inline in the request to Comfy, which passes them to ByteDance's BytePlus ModelArk. Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area". The answer is the crop's own shape at 1 to 4.2 megapixels (the range the Router's schema gives this model), without a watermark. At most ten pictures go in, none steeper than 16:1 and none over 25 MB, the Router's own cap per picture (an opaque one goes as JPEG).

oxen.note: Runs on Oxen.ai (one key for many models); not run against the live API yet (written from Oxen's docs and model list, 2026-09-26). The pictures go inline (data URLs, which Oxen's docs allow but do not recommend for production) in the request to Oxen.ai, which runs the model or passes it on; Oxen keeps every generated image in your Oxen account, and its terms could not be read, so how long it keeps what you send is not stated. Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. Seedream 5.0 Pro on Oxen takes no "auto" aspect: the preset closest to the crop is sent (eight of them). An answer of another shape is centre-cropped. Size 1K or 2K, on auto the smallest that covers the crop; up to ten pictures, none steeper than 16:1; no watermark. List price $0.045 (2026-09-26).

magnific.note: Runs on Magnific (Freepik's API, api.magnific.com) with the Magnific key; every API call costs credits, whatever the web plan says; not run against the live API yet. The pictures go inline (base64) to Magnific / Freepik (Freepik Company S.L., Málaga, Spain), which hosts inputs and outputs on its own or its providers' platforms, uses them for security and to improve its products and not to train its own models; the docs do not say where the model runs. Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area". Seedream 5.0 Pro on Magnific renders eight preset shapes only: the crop's context is widened to the nearest one the picture can give, so the answer lines up with it (a crop that cannot be widened is centre-cropped). At most ten pictures go in (the crop, Original and the reference layers), each at least 256 × 256 and at most 10 MB (an opaque one goes as JPEG). Resolution 1.5k or 2k. Magnific's price list names no price for 5.0 Pro.
